martha.name: Martha
martha.comment: Martha, today's a swimmer's dream, with great conditions from 09:00–11:00 and temps perfect for a dip. Not ideal for running, but who needs that when you can hit the pool? Grab your gear and make the most of it, maybe even surprise Britt with a swim when they get home.

britt.name: Britt
britt.comment: Britt, today's a swimmer's dream - 20.4°C to 36.8°C and not a cloud in sight, perfect for a dip between 09:00–11:00. Not exactly ideal for cycling with that noticeable headwind, but if you're up for it, grab Martha and hit the road early, around 06:00–08:00 before it gets too hot.
